items.notes: Headline: Biden Staffers Find Powerful New Home to Keep Up Fight Against Trump; published 4 June 2025, updated 5 June 2025. Yahoo syndicates the same text. items.to: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University
items.capacity: Director of the CyberAI Project and Senior Faculty Fellow (also Assistant Teaching Professor, Georgetown School of Foreign Service)
items.fact: Buchanan was CSET's CyberAI Project director and Senior Faculty Fellow. He was styled CSET Senior Faculty Fellow by 22 October 2019 and was principal investigator of the CyberAI project launched 21 November 2019. He left for the Biden White House in 2021 (exact months not found). CSET's founding funder was the Open Philanthropy Project, with a $55 million grant announced 28 February 2019; CSET was established in January 2019.
items.quote: Funded by the Open Philanthropy Project
items.missing: Exact start and end months of his CSET employment; a dated CSET record of his departure.
items.notes: CSET staff bio (cset.georgetown.edu/staff/ben-buchanan/, read): former Director of the CyberAI Project and Senior Faculty Fellow. CyberAI launch and $2 million Hewlett Foundation grant with Buchanan as PI (cset.georgetown.edu/article/cset-launching-cybersecurity-and-ai-project/, read, dated 21 Nov 2019). End year 2021 rests on the Washington Examiner account and FedSoc/Knight bios giving White House service from 2021. Funder amount: Georgetown's release confirms $55 million; a LongTermWiki page (search result, not read) gives $15 million, which conflicts. Later Open Philanthropy expansion and a $42 million CSET grant appear in search summaries only.
